func evalRPN(tokens []string) int {
   stack := make([]int, 0)

   for _, token := range tokens {
       switch token {
       case "+":
           a := stack[len(stack)-1]
           b := stack[len(stack)-2]
           stack = stack[:len(stack)-2]
           stack = append(stack, b+a)
       case "-":
           a := stack[len(stack)-1]
           b := stack[len(stack)-2]
           stack = stack[:len(stack)-2]
           stack = append(stack, b-a)
       case "*":
           a := stack[len(stack)-1]
           b := stack[len(stack)-2]
           stack = stack[:len(stack)-2]
           stack = append(stack, b*a)
       case "/":
           a := stack[len(stack)-1]
           b := stack[len(stack)-2]
           stack = stack[:len(stack)-2]
           stack = append(stack, b/a)
       default:
           num, _ := strconv.Atoi(token)
           stack = append(stack, num)
       }
   }

   return stack[0]
}
